definitions.explanation: The art and practice of designing and creating gardens and outdoor spaces. Includes both Japanese-style and Western-style garden design.

examples.japanese: {造園|ぞうえん}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
{造園|ぞうえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。

⟦{日本庭園|にほんていえん}→日本庭園：19199_nihonteien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{造園|ぞうえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Creating a Japanese garden requires many years of experience.

notes:
{造園|ぞうえん} combines {造|ぞう} (create, build) + {園|えん} (garden, park). It covers both the art and the professional practice of designing and creating gardens and outdoor spaces.

COMPOUNDS:
- {造園|ぞうえん}{業|ぎょう}: landscaping industry
- {造園|ぞうえん}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: landscaping company
- {造園|ぞうえん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: landscaping techniques
- {造園|ぞうえん}⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧: landscape design
- {造園|ぞうえん}{家|か}: landscape architect/gardener

AS A SURU VERB:
{造園|ぞうえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to landscape, to create a garden. Less common than the noun usage.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese {造園|ぞうえん} has a rich tradition encompassing styles like {枯山水|かれさんすい} (dry landscape gardens) and {回遊式庭園|かいゆうしきていえん} (strolling gardens). Professional landscapers may specialize in ⟦{日本庭園|にほんていえん}→日本庭園：19199_nihonteien⟧ (Japanese gardens) or {洋風庭園|ようふうていえん} (Western-style gardens).
